args.command:
set +e
{
  echo "=== HOST ==="; hostname
  echo "=== ZEN OPS WORKER ==="; systemctl is-active zen-ops-worker.service
  echo "=== REPO ==="; git -C /opt/zen/ZEN-MA2-Agent status --short --branch
  git -C /opt/zen/ZEN-MA2-Agent rev-parse HEAD
  git -C /opt/zen/ZEN-MA2-Agent log -1 --format=%h:%s
  echo "=== CODEX ==="; command -v codex || true; codex --version 2>&1 || true
  echo "=== CLAUDE ==="; command -v claude || true; claude --version 2>&1 || true
  echo "=== SPATIAL FILES ==="; rg --files /opt/zen/ZEN-MA2-Agent/zen_ma2_agent /opt/zen/ZEN-MA2-Agent/tests 2>&1 | rg 'spatial|position|group_order' | head -80
} > /tmp/mini-spatial-preflight.txt 2>&1
python3 -c 'import json,sys,datetime; print(json.dumps({"schema":"zen.mini.preflight.v1","captured_at":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"output":sys.stdin.read()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))' < /tmp/mini-spatial-preflight.txt > /tmp/mini-spatial-preflight.json
blob="$(base64 -w0 /tmp/mini-spatial-preflight.json)"
gh api --method PUT repos/zen0904/ZEN-MA2-Agent/contents/ops/evidence/mini-spatial-preflight-20261001.json -f message="ops: preserve Mini spatial preflight evidence" -f content="$blob" -f branch=zen-ops-control > /tmp/mini-spatial-preflight-push.json
python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/mini-spatial-preflight-push.json")); print("COMMIT="+d["commit"]["sha"]); print("FILE="+d["content"]["path"])'
cat /tmp/mini-spatial-preflight.txt

meta.summary: Read-only Mini Spatial vNext preflight, retain nonsecret evidence on the ops branch
